findings.rule: Accessibility WCAG 1.4.4 and issue constraint 'layouts must not clip at font scale 2.0'; Reviewer A M1 disposition 'fixed'
findings.trigger: At font scale 2.0, even at the 374dp prototype width, the done step renders '✓' / 'PROFI…'. Baselines chrome_stepbar_2/3_prototype-font-200_dark.png at c2f22b16 show this. Cause: maxLines=2 plus Ellipsis, and the weight(1f, fill=false) pills in TmrStepBar.kt:51 cap each pill at a third of the row while the short '2 JOB' pill leaves its share unused. At 337dp 'TAILOR' is also at risk. In W3-A the step bar sits between a 44dp back button and the action, which is narrower still. The tab label 'APPLICATIONS' breaks mid-word as 'APPLICAT'/'IONS'. A low-vision user who enlarged text loses visible content; the full text exists only in semantics. Prefer whole words: no ellipsis for chrome labels, step pills that wrap to a second row when enlarged (FlowRow), or tighter padding and letter-spacing. stepBarStaysInsideParentAtFontScale2 checks only bounds, so it passes with the ellipsis.
findings.title: Large text still truncates the done step label to 'PROFI…' and splits tab labels mid-word
findings.proof: At fontScale 2f and 337dp, capture onTextLayout for every step pill and tab label and assert !hasVisualOverflow. It fails at head on the '✓ Profile' pill.

findings.rule: Criterion 265-c8 (first frame at final position, asserted by a test); Reviewer A M6 disposition 'test added'
findings.trigger: Mutation: TmrToast.kt:96 Animatable(0f) regardless of motion.reduced. The animateTo branch is skipped under reduced, so the toast stays at alpha 0 and +12dp forever, which means it is invisible. toastReducedMotionFirstFrameIsFinal compares two reads (after 32 ms and after 2032 ms) that are identical under the mutation, so it passes. toastSitsAtGutterAndToastTop uses '>= toastTop' and ignores alpha, so it passes too. No test fails when reduced-motion toasts never appear.
findings.title: Toast reduced-motion test cannot fail for the mutation it was added for
findings.proof: Under Reduced, after the first frame assert toast.top == toastTop + 8dp (±0.5) or equal to the motion-enabled settled top. Also assert the layer alpha is 1, e.g. compare captureToImage against the settled frame.

findings.rule: Accessibility WCAG 2.2.1 Timing Adjustable; Reviewer A M5 disposition (recommended timeout)
findings.trigger: minSdk is 26. On API 26-28 with TalkBack on, the 'Applied, marked today' + Undo toast still disappears at a fixed 3200 ms. Both the default provider (line 46) and this host guard skip the recommended timeout below Q. The guard also ignores an injected provider below Q, so a caller cannot supply a fallback. Compose M3 SnackbarHost (calculateRecommendedTimeoutMillis) and MDC Snackbar make an actionable message indefinite when touch exploration is enabled below API 29. No non-timed path exists here.
findings.title: Actionable toast has no non-timed path below API 29 with TalkBack
findings.proof: Robolectric @Config(sdk = [28]) with touch exploration enabled: show a toast with an action, advance 3200 ms, assert state.current is not null.

findings.rule: Review checklist 5: a test must fail if the fix is reverted (Reviewer A M2/M3 'no clipping, tested')
findings.trigger: topBarStaysInsideParentAtFontScale2 and toastActionHasNoClippingAtFontScale2 assert that the 'Save'/'Undo' Text bounds lie inside the target bounds. A Text measured under a fixed parent height is coerced to that height, so containment holds even when glyphs clip. Also, 13sp Space Mono at 2.0 (about 38.5dp line) fits the old fixed height(44)/height(40). Reverting heightIn to height passes both tests.
findings.title: Large-text 'no clipping' tests check bounds containment, which cannot detect clipping
findings.proof: Capture onTextLayout on the action labels (or use a two-line label at 2.0) and assert !didOverflowHeight. It fails with height(40.dp) restored.

findings.rule: Android accessibility: paneTitle names the pane that appeared (Reviewer A L1)
findings.trigger: Every sheet, whether 'Change status', the delete-account confirmation or payment failed, announces the fixed pane title 'Sheet'. TmrBottomSheet takes no title, so W3-A callers cannot give TalkBack a meaningful announcement.
findings.title: Sheet pane title is the generic string 'Sheet' and cannot be set by the caller
